idea-plugin.name: Nord Recharged
idea-plugin.description:
Nord Recharged - Beautiful Arctic-inspired Themes for IntelliJ

Five carefully crafted themes combining the elegance of the Nord color palette with modern UI design. Perfect for developers who love clean, minimal aesthetics with optimal readability.

What's Included:

  • Nord Recharged Dark - Pure Nord dark theme with Polar Night backgrounds
  • Nordic Recharged Dark - Nordic (Neovim) palette with darker backgrounds and Aurora accents
  • Nord Recharged Light - Clean light variant perfect for bright environments
  • OneNord Dark Recharged - One Dark style with Nord colors (purple keywords, yellow classes)
  • OneNord Light Recharged - One Light style with vibrant Nord palette

Key Features:

  • 100% Official Palettes: Authentic Nord colors, the OneNord palette by @rmehri01, and the Nordic (Neovim) palette
  • Islands UI Support: Fully optimized for JetBrains' modern UI
  • Enhanced Readability: Theme-specific typography and italic comments
  • Comprehensive Java Syntax: Optimized highlighting attributes
  • Multi-Language: Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and more
  • Eye-Friendly: Optimized contrast for long coding sessions
  • Subtle Accents: Blue-tinted headers for visual identity

Perfect For:

  • Nord theme enthusiasts
  • Developers migrating from VS Code or Atom
  • Anyone seeking elegant, minimal themes
  • Projects requiring extended focus time

Installation:

  1. Install this plugin
  2. Restart your IDE
  3. Go to Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance → Theme
  4. Select your preferred Nord Recharged theme

Color Philosophy:

Nord Recharged: Minimalist with subtle blue accents, cyan selections
Nordic Recharged: Darker Polar Night surfaces with Aurora accents
OneNord Recharged: More colorful with purple keywords, yellow classes, red variables

Links:

  • GitHub Repository
  • Report Issues
  • Nord Color Palette

Inspired by Nord JetBrains and OneNord JetBrains themes. Created with care for the community.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.6.0 (2026-10-30)

Added

  • Nordic Recharged Dark - new theme based on the Nordic Neovim palette with darker backgrounds, Aurora accents, and Nordic typography.
  • Nord Recharged Light parity - the light scheme now mirrors the full Nord Dark structure, including all base attributes and UI keys.
  • OneNord Light parity - the light scheme now mirrors the updated OneNord Dark structure.

Changed

  • Nord Dark/Light refresh - updated editor layout, attributes, UI surfaces, and contrast while keeping the official Nord palette.
  • OneNord Dark/Light refresh - updated One Dark Vivid configuration, typography, and UI structure.
  • Theme registration - Nordic Recharged Dark is registered in the plugin descriptor.

Fixed

  • Indent guides - regular, visual, selected-scope, and matched-brace indent guides are now visible in Nord Dark and Nord Light.
  • Missing base attributes - completed inherited attributes for both Nord themes.
  • Console colors - corrected magenta output in the Nord themes.
  • Contrast - improved notification, tooltip, search match, run widget, and selection contrast.

Full Changelog on GitHub
